architecture.mechanism: Optimization of lubrication formula to reduce friction coefficient and wear at the cam follower interface.
architecture.intervention: Reformulate engine oil with specific additives targeting the cam-tappet interface rheology to minimize friction under constant speed and temperature conditions.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduced wear rates on cam lobes and tappets, preventing premature failure and subsequent damage to the camshaft and rocker assembly.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the engine valvetrain assembly on a test bench under constant camshaft speed and inlet lubricant temperature using the new formula, then measure tappet wear with a two-dimensional optical surface profilometer; failure is confirmed if wear metrics do not decrease compared to the baseline formulation.
